title: FeltCraft-Lifetimes v1 causal lifetime benchmark and attributable Dream--LoRA--Think architecture
summary: Replace the small finite puzzle as the paper center with a matched RANDOM/MOTIF lifetime benchmark, constructive held-out action targets, explicit causal attribution, and an exactly separated THINK--DREAM--grounding--SLEEP--MEMORY pipeline. This proposal grants no present authority. Exact-byte ratification could release only deterministic local CPU falsification of the new FeltCraft-Lifetimes instrument and analytical comparison with the already specified PCFL-Stream fallback; it cannot release PCFL-Stream implementation, tokenizers, models, LoRA, GPU/remote work, locked studies, promotion, or claims.
system_thesis: The scientific object is when a fixed pretrained agent can transform its own immutable public action--outcome lifetime into connected lossy experiential knowledge that improves unseen constructive action beyond native context, and when exact text or graph memory should remain preferable. DREAM may propose reusable local structure but not certify truth; later ordinary public outcomes ground it; SLEEP only deterministically compiles supported content; MEMORY LoRA may transport or amortize local associations but neither discover nor reason; recurrent THINK reconstructs cited paths and acts. Lifetime length, genuinely new causal information, compressibility, representation/access, and causal intervention are varied independently, with useful negative phase diagrams preserved.

nodes.before: The complete recurrent learning architecture and its organ boundaries are not bound to the lifetime benchmark.

nodes.before: Parametric memory can be conflated with a literal graph, discovery, reasoning, or scalable access.

Headline LoRA reads are generative one-atom reads; frozen public constant-size recognition candidates are assisted diagnostics. All hidden candidate work, scans, tokens, latency, bytes, rank, modules, and precision are reported.
nodes.rationale: LoRA earns only transport/amortization credit unless the same-corpus, resource, and causal tests support more.

nodes.before: Fixed-deck representation/use evidence may be mislabeled online learning or learned control.
nodes.after: Reserve separate dormant studies for randomized on-policy collector x compiler assignment with a predesigned interventional mediation analysis, and for a cross-life LOOP adapter trained only on operation tokens from typed trajectories and frozen inside evaluation lives.
nodes.rationale: The action--experience--memory--action flywheel and learned phi are higher claims that common-deck Paper 1 cannot inherit.

claims.before: No continued lifetime acquisition/retention/composition result exists.
